task.description:
Execute the full test suite for Epic 2 Run 1.

1. Run all integration tests in tests/integration/entity_subsystem_test.zig.
2. Run 'zig build test' to ensure no regressions in the core build.
3. Run 'zig build bench' precheck to ensure benchmark environment is clean.
4. Produce a YAML test report to tests/reports/report-20260612-exp201-202.yaml.
acceptance_criteria: All 12 integration tests in entity_subsystem_test.zig pass
YAML report generated in the correct format

result.summary: Entity Subsystem integration tests failed. EXP-201 passed (validation), but EXP-202 failed (integration) due to schema/table reference issues.

issues.description: Relation process_events does not exist in integration tests. Commands.zig uses unqualified names which fail even when search_path is set to tenant_default, possibly because some tables only exist in tenant schemas or the search_path is lost in nested transactions.
zig build migrate skips all migrations on test DB, preventing schema refreshment.
